_comment: The open-weight operators run_batch.sh --agent codex knows (ab_helper.py codex_model).
hf: the model's id on Hugging Face Inference Providers, and route: the provider each request is pinned to
(the id is sent as '<id>:<route>'). Without a pin the router picks a provider per request, and providers
differ in price and may differ in quantization, so a batch would mix servings. Kimi is pinned to its own
company's endpoint (moonshotai serves it through HF); DeepSeek has no first-party provider on HF, so it is
pinned to deepinfra, which serves both models.
vendor: [provider, model id] on the company's own Responses endpoint (--provider vendor).
price: USD per million tokens, the accounting price of the model whichever provider served it (the
user's choice, 2026-11-17: each company's own API price; DeepSeek at its peak-hour rate). input = a cache
miss, cached_input = a cache hit, cache_write = input written to the provider's prompt cache (default: input),
output. ab_helper.codex_cost prices a run's tokens with it; metrics.json records it as cost_basis.
route_listing: what the pinned HF route listed (https://router.huggingface.co/v1/models, 2026-11-17), for
reference only; the listing gives no cached-input price.

effort: the reasoning effort a run sends when run_batch.sh gets no --effort (Codex's model_reasoning_effort -> reasoning_effort). 'medium', as the Claude batches ran (user, 2026-11-17). DeepSeek on its deepinfra route accepts low, medium, high, xhigh and max (2026-11-18, two calls per level on one bending problem): low to xhigh, and no effort at all, reasoned alike (about 1 400-2 100 reasoning tokens), and only max reasoned longer (2 600-6 300), so max is its highest effort (--effort max; output/agentic_batch50_deepseek_max). A single call per level the day before had suggested no effort reasoned longest (1306 vs about 520 tokens); two calls per level vary as much as that. Kimi accepts low/medium/high through HF (2026-11-17); higher levels were not tried. DeepSeek's own API takes medium too.

price.source: DeepSeek API, peak-hour price (cache miss 0.3, cache hit 0.006, output 1.2 USD per M)
Moonshot API price (input 2, cached input 0.2, cache write at the default 5-min TTL 2, output 10 USD per M)
